age_limit.details: For outsiders applying for the post, the candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 34 years as on 01.07.2026. For retired persons, the age must not have exceeded 64 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

eligible outsiders possessing the required graduation and age criteria may be appointed.
how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed proforma application form along with the bio-data format provided in the notification.
Fill in all the required details in the application form accurately.
Attach recent passport-size colour photographs to the application form.
Enclose duly attested copies of qualification certificates, proof of date of birth, and retirement proceedings (if applicable).
Submit the duly filled application strictly in the prescribed proforma to the Office of the Principal District Judge, Warangal on or before 24 October 2026 by 05:00 p.m. either by post or in person.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted strictly in the prescribed proforma along with all necessary attested copies of documents. Applications received after the due date and time (24.10.2026 by 05:00 p.m.) will not be entertained. The Spl. Judicial Second Class Magistrate Courts function for (05) days in a week, from Monday to Friday, between 7:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis for a period of two years and does not confer any right for future employment on a regular basis. No TA will be paid for candidates for journeys performed in connection with recruitment. The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason thereof. Applications with insufficient information, without necessary enclosures, and without proper attestation will be summarily rejected. The office will not be responsible for any delay caused by postal or courier services.

faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Court Assistant post.
